now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#53
now.text: Remy resents Rogue's weekend with her old flame Cody, and they grow closer on a ski trip in Germany.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Remy loves but cannot touch.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#45
proposed.text: Remy resents Rogue's weekend with her old flame Cody.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#53
split.text: Remy and Rogue grow closer on a ski trip in Germany.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Remy loves but cannot touch.

changes.evidence: Rogue's weekend with Cody, much to Gambit's annoyance, is #45 'Love in Vain'; the Germany ski trip where Gambit and Rogue enjoy each other's company is #53 'Nightcrawler'. The stage at #53 tells a #45 event.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#59
now.text: Graydon is Kurt's half-brother, son of Mystique and Sabretooth. Told to kill his mutant family, he lures Kurt into a trap and fails.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Graydon's mutant half-brother. Graydon tries to kill him.

proposed.text: Graydon is Kurt's half-brother, son of Mystique and Sabretooth. To win back the Friends of Humanity, he plots to kill his mutant family, lures Kurt into a trap, and fails.

changes.evidence: #59 'Bloodlines': no one tells Graydon to kill his family. The Friends of Humanity council shames him over his parentage, and he comes up with the plan to have Mystique, Kurt and Rogue killed himself to win his place back (Marvel Database synopsis: he 'tries to return to the friends of humanity by capturing and delivering his mother and step brother').

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#59
now.text: Graydon is the son of Rogue's foster mother Mystique. Ordered to wipe out his mutant family, he lures Rogue, Kurt and Wolverine into a deadly trap.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue's foster brother, who wants her dead.

proposed.text: Graydon is the son of Rogue's foster mother Mystique. Plotting to wipe out his mutant family to win back the Friends of Humanity, he lures Rogue, Kurt and Wolverine into a deadly trap.

changes.evidence: #59 'Bloodlines': the plan to kill his mutant family is Graydon's own, offered to the Friends of Humanity council to cleanse himself; the council does not order it.

now.title: X-Men '97#10
now.text: Swept back in time together, Rogue and Kurt are stranded in ancient Egypt and look for a way home.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue's brother, lost with her in ancient Egypt.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Kurt's sister, lost with him in ancient Egypt.

proposed.text: Swept back in time together, Rogue and Kurt end up stranded in ancient Egypt.

changes.evidence: #10 (Tolerance Is Extinction Part 3) only shows Rogue, Nightcrawler, Beast, Xavier and Magneto arriving in Ancient Egypt and meeting En Sabah Nur; Beast, Rogue and Nightcrawler trying to build a time machine home is #13 (Rise of Apocalypse Part 1).
